title: Winey Velvety Saudi-Arabian Panang Curry Paste Curry
description: A delicious and comforting Saudi-Arabian dish featuring a rich and creamy panang curry paste, perfect for a sick day. This recipe is halal-friendly and can be made with easily available ingredients.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of coconut oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and saut5; until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add 2 cloves of minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add 1 tablespoon of grated fresh ginger and cook for 30 seconds.
Add 1 tablespoon of panang curry paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add 1 cup of chopped tomatoes and 1 cup of coconut milk. Stir well to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and let cook for 10-12 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro, if desired.
